label: Greet someone
canDo: I can greet another person politely.

label: Say your name
canDo: I can introduce myself by name.

label: Ask for help
canDo: I can ask another person for assistance.

label: Say you are learning
canDo: I can say that I am learning this language.

label: Ask for repetition
canDo: I can ask somebody to repeat a sentence.

label: Ask someone to slow down
canDo: I can ask someone to speak more slowly.

label: Say you do not understand
canDo: I can tell someone I do not understand.

label: Request an item
canDo: I can ask for an everyday item politely.

label: Ask for a price
canDo: I can ask how much something costs.

label: Ask where a place is
canDo: I can ask for the location of a place.

label: Explain what you need
canDo: I can explain what I need.

label: Ask to pay by card
canDo: I can ask whether I can pay by card.

label: Ask about availability
canDo: I can ask when someone is available.

label: Say you cannot come
canDo: I can say I cannot come tomorrow.

label: Ask someone to write it
canDo: I can request important information in writing.

label: Explain there is a problem
canDo: I can say that I have a problem.

label: Check your understanding
canDo: I can confirm that I understood correctly.

label: Ask about English
canDo: I can ask whether someone speaks English.
